Prepare a vault on this device.

USAGE
  sennit init [flags]
  sennit init --new-phrase

FLAGS
  --new-phrase       Print a fresh recovery phrase and exit without touching
                     the vault
  --wait duration    How long to wait for the indexer to finish funding host
                     accounts (default 60s)

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir         Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url      Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline          Work from this device only, without contacting the indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when       When to colour output: auto, always or never (default
                     auto)
  --verbose          Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit init --new-phrase
  $ sennit init
  $ sennit init --offline
